description: It shows the watch list after the call. A call without packages answers items and the item counts. A call with packages answers only counts.

items.description: A watched item. endpoint names the tool it watches, and the other members hold its saved arguments.

endpoint.description: It is cve_lookup, kev_lookup, cve_exploit, product_exposure, cve_search, dns_lookup, ssl_check, whois_lookup, headers_check, cert_search, package_check or ip_lookup.

cve_id.description: Present only on cve_lookup, kev_lookup and cve_exploit items.

vendor.description: Present on product_exposure items, and on cve_search items when the filter is set.

product.description: Present on product_exposure items, and on cve_search items when the filter is set.

version.description: Present only on product_exposure and package_check items. null for an item of every version.

product_has_cves.description: Present only on product_exposure items. false when no vulnerable product has the pair yet. The item still matches once one appears, but false often means a misspelled name.

severity.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set.

cwe_id.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set.

min_cvss.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set.

min_epss.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set.

in_kev.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set. true keeps the CVEs in CISA KEV, and false keeps the CVEs outside it.

known_ransomware.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set. It is then true.

has_nuclei_template.description: Present only on cve_search items, when the filter is set. It is then true.

domain.description: Present only on dns_lookup, ssl_check, whois_lookup, headers_check and cert_search items.

items.description: Present only when the call has no packages. A call without action lists every item, oldest first. An add or a remove lists the one item it changed. A remove that matched nothing, and a clear, list none.

item_count.description: Present only when the call has no packages. It counts the items that are not package items, after the call.

item_limit.description: Present only when the call has no packages. It is the cap on item_count, 100.

package_item_count.description: It counts the package items after the call.

package_item_limit.description: It is the cap on package_item_count, 500.

added_count.description: Present only on an add with packages. It counts the packages the call added.

unchanged_count.description: Present only when the call has packages. An add counts the packages the list already held. A remove counts the packages the list did not hold.

removed_count.description: Present only on a remove with packages. It counts the packages the call removed.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
